paragraphs: QQQ is -1.56% versus the prior close. The Nasdaq Score is -48/100 (Strong Negative). Score path: pre-market -27 → now -48; open -28 → now -48 (deteriorated 20 points).

The main live drivers are Volatility are a headwind: VXN 23.98 (+4.76%) | VIX 17.13 (+4.07%). It changed from positive to negative after the baseline snapshot. Oil is a headwind for Nasdaq: Brent $107.38 (+1.38%) | WTI $99.18 (+1.24%). Rates are a headwind: the 10Y is 5.106%, -0.6 bp since the opening snapshot.
QQQ and its internal leadership are diverging, so the index move has weaker confirmation (semiconductors negative, mega-caps mixed, breadth mixed).

What would change the view: improvement would require a sustained 10Y move back below roughly 5.05%, semiconductors regaining leadership versus QQQ, broader participation. Deterioration would be reinforced by the 10Y remaining above 5.05% or extending higher.
